service: Free Late Birth Registration (Mobile Birth Registration)
description: The City Civil Registry visits every barangay to offer free late birth registration to Taguig-born residents whose birth was never registered.
whoMayAvail: Taguig-born residents whose birth has not yet been registered

detailedRequirements.requirement: Registration form for Certificate of Live Birth (COLB), typewritten or computerized, signed and notarized
Notarized Affidavit for Delayed Registration of Birth
Certified true copy of the parents' Marriage Certificate (if parents are married)
Notarized Affidavit of Acknowledgment/Admission of Paternity and Affidavit to Use the Surname of the Father (if parents are not married)
Notarized Affidavit of Two Disinterested Persons who witnessed the birth
Certification from the Barangay Chairman of where the mother lived on the day of birth

Any 2 of: original Baptismal Certificate; Medical Certification or Immunization Card from the Health Center; certified true copy of Form 137 (ages 7–17); certified true copy of Voter's Registration (18 and above)

steps: Check the City Civil Registry – City of Taguig Facebook page for the free late birth registration schedule in your barangay.
Bring the complete requirements to the registration site on the scheduled day.

service: Free Mass Wedding (Kasalang Bayan) and Renewal of Vows
description: A free mass wedding officiated by the Mayor, held 4 times a year for couples who want to formalize their union. The City prepares the wine, cake, flowers and coins.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Marriage License (if available)
Birth Certificate
Birth Certificate of child/children
Certificate of No Marriage (CENOMAR)
Affidavit of Cohabitation
Valid ID (PhilHealth ID not accepted)

steps: Submit the requirements at the City Civil Registry Office, Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM.
Follow the City Civil Registry – City of Taguig Facebook page for the Kasalang Bayan schedule.

service: Timely Registration of Certificate of Marriage
description: Register a marriage with the City Civil Registry. File within 15 days of the wedding for marriages with a marriage license, and within 30 days for marriages under Art. 34 of the Family Code (cohabitation), PD 1083 (Muslim marriages) and other Family Code articles.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Application form for Certificate of Marriage (4 copies, typewritten, no erasures)
Muslim attachment for Marriage (Muslims only, 4 copies)
Original Marriage License
Original Affidavit of Cohabitation (couples living together for at least 5 years, Art. 34 of the Family Code; 4 copies)
Notarized request for the celebration of marriage in a place other than authorized by law (if the wedding was held outside a church or mosque; dated and notarized before the wedding)
Certificate of Registration of Authority to Solemnize Marriage (CRASM) of the solemnizing officer
Valid ID

steps: Prepare all original requirements and a valid ID, with 2 photocopies of each.

Submit them in person at the City Civil Registry, Ground Floor, City Hall Annex Bldg., Gen. Luna St., Tuktukan, Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM. The husband, wife, pastor, ustadz/imam or church clerk must appear personally, with a Special Power of Attorney (SPA) letter from the couple.
The Certificate of Marriage is released 10 days after posting.

service: Delayed Registration of Certificate of Marriage
description: Register a marriage that was not registered within the deadline (15 days for marriages with a license, 30 days for cohabitation and PD 1083 marriages). Marriages more than 1 year late need extra documents.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Application form for Certificate of Marriage (4 copies, typewritten, no erasures)
Muslim attachment for Marriage (Muslims only, 4 copies)
Duly accomplished Affidavit for Delayed Registration
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Back of the application form for Certificate of Marriage

detailedRequirements.requirement: Original Marriage License
Original Affidavit of Cohabitation (couples living together for at least 5 years, Art. 34 of the Family Code; 4 copies)
Notarized request for the celebration of marriage in a place other than authorized by law (if the wedding was held outside a church or mosque; dated and notarized before the wedding)
Certificate of Registration of Authority to Solemnize Marriage (CRASM) of the solemnizing officer
Valid ID

For Muslim couples, the affidavit must state: the couple's details, the dates and place of marriage and the name of the imam/ustadz; that the marriage was solemnized under Presidential Decree No. 1083; and that the marriage was among Muslims or members of ethnic cultural communities and solemnized according to their customs
If more than 1 year late: latest PSA CENOMAR of the groom and bride (valid for 6 months)
If more than 1 year late: latest original PSA No Record/Negative Result for the Certificate of Marriage (valid for 1 year)
If more than 1 year late: certification with a certified true copy of the book record
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Church or Hall of Justice where the wedding was held

detailedRequirements.requirement: If more than 1 year late: picture of the couple at the wedding ceremony
If more than 1 year late: notarized Affidavit of Delayed Registration, signed by the groom, bride, solemnizing officer and two witnesses

steps: Prepare all original requirements and a valid ID, with 2 photocopies of each.

Submit them in person at the City Civil Registry, Ground Floor, City Hall Annex Bldg., Gen. Luna St., Tuktukan, Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM. The husband, wife, pastor, ustadz/imam or church clerk must appear personally, with a Special Power of Attorney (SPA) letter from the couple.
The Certificate of Marriage is released 10 days after posting.

description: How to register a death with the City Civil Registry, whether the person died in a hospital or at home. Forms and other requirements are available at the City Civil Registry office.
whoMayAvail: Only the spouse, child, parent or a relative of the deceased may get the death certificate. Bring a valid ID or another document proving you are a relative.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Death in a hospital: typewritten death certificate form, with the cause of death and a completed embalmer's box
Death at home: 4 original copies of Municipal Form 103, filled out by the funeral parlor
Death at home: all medical records of the deceased and a signed deceased retrieval form
Transfer Permit (if needed)
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Sanitation Office, City Health Office (CHO) Room 5

detailedRequirements.requirement: Valid ID or document proving you are a relative of the deceased

steps: Death in a hospital: (1) The hospital gives the typewritten death certificate form. (2) Bring the form to City Health Office (CHO) Room 5 for final review. (3) If needed, get a Transfer Permit from the Sanitation Office at CHO Room 5. (4) Register the death certificate at the City Civil Registry.

Death at home: (1) Get 4 original copies of Municipal Form 103 and have the funeral parlor fill them out. (2) Bring the form, all medical records and the signed deceased retrieval form to the barangay health center for an interview. (3) Bring the form, the cause of death and other documents to the City Health Office (CHO) for final review. (4) If needed, get a Transfer Permit from the Sanitation Office at CHO Room 5. (5) Register the death certificate at the City Civil Registry.
The City Civil Registry, Ground Floor, City Hall Annex Bldg., Gen. Luna St., Tuktukan is open Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM.
